landing.heroTitle: One identity for every furry corner of the internet
landing.heroSubtitle: Furdentity links your fursona's pages, socials and communities into a single, shareable profile.
landing.ctaBandTitle: Ready to bring your identity together?

features.title: Present your Fursona
features.text: One simple link to show everyone your fursona.

features.title: One profile, every link
features.text: Bundle all the places your fursona lives online in a single, tidy profile.

features.title: Built for the fandom
features.text: Made by and for the furry community, with the fandom's needs in mind.

login.heading: Login
login.intro: No password needed – we'll email you a login link.
login.linkSent: Check {email} for a login link. It expires in 15 minutes.

register.heading: Create your profile
register.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to create your account – no password needed.
register.title: Display name
register.titleHint: Shown as your display name. You can change this anytime later.
register.usernameHint: 3-32 characters, lowercase letters/numbers/-/_ only. This is permanent and can only be changed by an admin afterwards.

loginConfirm.heading: Logging you in
loginConfirm.invalid: This login link is missing its confirmation code.
